about.title: About BeniNect
about.lead: Transforming welfare delivery through technology and transparency
about.mission_desc: The BeniNect system aims to revolutionize how government welfare schemes reach citizens. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we ensure that benefits reach the right people at the right time, eliminating inefficiencies and promoting inclusive growth.
about.challenge1: High risk of inclusion/exclusion errors due to manual selection processes
about.challenge2: Poor tracking of beneficiary outcomes and progress
about.challenge3: Fragmented beneficiary data maintained by different departments
about.challenge4: Limited interoperability between state databases and central systems
about.solution_desc: BeniNect provides a unified, digital platform that integrates with existing government databases, uses AI-powered verification, and ensures end-to-end transparency in beneficiary identification and benefit delivery.
about.goal1_desc: Precise identification of eligible beneficiaries for all welfare schemes
about.goal2_desc: End-to-end project tracking and beneficiary monitoring
about.goal3_desc: Data-driven skill development and income-generation initiatives
about.goal4_desc: Enhanced accountability and reduced leakages in benefit delivery
